description: For injections f : A → B and g : B → A, the displayed Bernstein piecewise map is bijective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernstein_map_bijective.{u, v} {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (g : β → α)
  (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
  Function.Bijective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.bernsteinMap f g hg)
